_comment: ALLOWLIST, not a denylist — fail-closed by design (see
This service only has 3 CFN parameters total, so there's no shared
config-deploy.sh's — too small a set for a separate file to pay for
compute the 3 values inline, matching infra/deploy.sh's own heredoc.
EnvironmentName  — identity of the stack itself.
BucketName       — the PHYSICAL resource name of the S3 bucket this
template creates — changing it makes CloudFormation
try to REPLACE the bucket, not a config tweak.
